column1: # Skyrim SE mod manifest — tab-separated, one row per archive.
# Columns: enabled  name  archive  sha256  destination  archive_root  plugins  source_url
#   enabled      yes | no
#   archive      filename as downloaded, expected in ~/Downloads/skyrim-mods/
#   sha256       of that exact file; install refuses on mismatch
#   destination  root (beside SkyrimSE.exe) | data (into Data/)
#   archive_root subdir(s) inside the archive to install, ";"-separated.
#                Empty means the archive root. Needed for FOMOD installers,
#                which ship several mutually exclusive variants.
#   plugins      comma-separated .esp/.esm/.esl to enable, in load order
#   source_url   where it came from, so a re-download finds the same file
# Rows are GENERATED, not hand-written. There is no Nexus Premium on this
# account, so nothing downloads unattended: fetch the archives in a browser,
# drop them here, then
#     skyrim-install-mods --scan >> games/skyrim-special-edition/mods/manifest.tsv
# and edit the generated rows (fix the name, paste the real source_url, set the
# load order). The hashes are then taken from the files that were actually
# installed and played on game buildid 13189953 — which is the only claim this
# file can honestly make.
# Every line below was read off the mod's own Files tab on 2026-08-07 against
# game runtime 1.6.1170. Nexus requires a login to download, so these are
# fetched by hand; the pages themselves confirm the version support quoted.
# Order matters: 1 and 2 are prerequisites for 4 and 6.
#   1. SKSE64 — build 2.2.6, "Anniversary Edition" (game version 1.6.1170).
#      skse64_2_02_06.7z, https://skse.silverlock.org/  (NOT Nexus)
#      destination=root
#   2. Address Library for SKSE Plugins — v11
#      https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/32444
#      Main file "Address Library - All in one (all game versions)", 5.1 MB.
#      Prefer it over the older optional "All in one (1.6.X)" (2.3 MB, built
#      for 1.6.1179) — the main file carries every version's database.
#      destination=data
#   3. Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch (USSEP) — v4.3.8a
#      https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/266
#      destination=data
#   4. SSE Engine Fixes — TWO separate downloads from the same page:
#      https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/17230
#      a) "Engine Fixes - Main File", v7.0.20, 7.6 MB.
#         Page: "Supports SE 1.5.97 and AE 1.6.1170+". destination=data
#      b) "Engine Fixes - SKSE64 Preloader", v7, 24 KB.
#         Page: "extract it to your main Skyrim folder ... This file does not
#         go in your data folder." destination=root
#      The main file does nothing without the preloader.
#   5. SkyUI — main file is **v6.11**, 2.6 MB
#      https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/12604
#      The page header still reads 6.9; the current main file is 6.11 and says
#      "Supports 1.5.97 and 1.6.1170". Take the file version, not the header.
#      destination=data
#   6. SSE Display Tweaks — v0.5.16, 182 KB
#      https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/34705
#      Page: "SE 1.5.23 - 1.5.97 / AE 1.6.xxx". destination=data
#      This is what makes the 60 fps cap in scopebuddy.conf removable; do not
#      drop the cap before it is installed.
#      Skip its optional "High performance configuration" on the Iris Xe — the
#      page says "for high refresh rate monitors and fast GPUs/CPUs. Don't use
#      on low-end systems." It is a candidate for the RX 6700 XT machine only.
# Steam updates orphan SKSE: the loader is locked to a runtime version, so a
# Bethesda patch breaks it until a matching build ships. Keep Properties →
# Updates → "Only update this game when I launch it" set, and re-check
# skse.silverlock.org before updating. A game that suddenly starts vanilla with
# no mods is usually this, not a broken install.
